annotations.title: Find hotel rooms with a jacuzzi or hot tub

description: Find hotels where a named room type has its own jacuzzi, whirlpool or hot tub inside the room, in a city, town, state, province, UK nation, or around a point. Returns each hotel with the exact room to book, the tub type, room extras (fireplace, tub for two, heart-shaped, pets), Google rating, the date and source of the last check, and its tubroom.com page. Best rated first, or nearest first for a point search.

features.description: Room extras the user asked for, such as a fireplace in the room or bringing a dog. A hotel is returned only when it has every extra listed. romantic means a source states a tub for two, a fireplace, a heart-shaped tub or a honeymoon room.

lat.description: Latitude of a spot the user wants to stay near (a venue, attraction or address), for example 35.7143 for downtown Gatlinburg. Send it together with lng instead of place.

limit.description: How many hotels to show the user. The total count is returned either way.

lng.description: Longitude of the same spot, for example -83.5102. Send it together with lat.

min_rating.description: Lowest Google guest rating the user will accept, for example 4.0 for well-reviewed hotels only.

place.description: Where the user wants to stay, as they said it: a city or town ("Gatlinburg", "Pigeon Forge, TN", "Toronto"), a US state, Canadian province or UK nation ("Ohio", "Ontario", "Wales"), or a country. Add the state after a comma when a city name is shared. Omit it for a search around a point.

radius_miles.description: How far from the lat/lng spot the user is willing to stay, in miles. Ignored for a place search.

tub_type.description: Set only when the user names a specific kind of tub; hotels label the same jetted tub differently, so leaving it out finds more rooms.

name: search_tub_rooms

credit.description: Attribution line to show with the answer.

items.description: One hotel with a tub room, as listed on tubroom.com.

checked.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the tub room was last confirmed.

city_page.description: The full city or area list on tubroom.com.

confirmed_on.description: Where the tub room was confirmed (hotel website, chain site, OTA).

distance_km.description: Distance from the searched point in km (point searches only).

distance_miles.description: Distance from the searched point in miles (point searches only).

fireplace.description: A source places a fireplace in the tub room.

google_rating.description: Google rating out of 5, or null.

list.description: The Tubroom city or area list it belongs to.

page.description: The hotel page on tubroom.com, with dates and booking. Give this link to the user.

pets_allowed.description: Google Hotels lists pets as allowed at the hotel.

region.description: US state code, Canadian province code, or UK nation.

romantic.description: Why the room counts as romantic, from what a source states (empty if none).

room_to_book.description: The named room type that has the tub. Book this room, not a standard room.

suite.description: The tub room is a suite.

town.description: Town or suburb the hotel is in.

tub.description: Tub types stated for that room.

two_person_tub.description: A source says the tub is sized for two.

list_page.description: The tubroom.com page with the full list for this place, when there is one.

note.description: Extra guidance: other places with the same name, or nearest covered places when nothing matched.

place.description: The place the search resolved to, or the point searched.

total.description: How many hotels matched before the limit.

title: Find hotel rooms with a jacuzzi or hot tub
